title: Foundational x86-64 slice
statement: The book's foundational x86-64 slice is a version-pinned, 64-bit user-mode subset with named general-purpose registers, instruction pointer, selected condition flags, ordinary loads and stores, integer arithmetic and logic, comparisons, branches, calls, and precisely declared fault assumptions. Vector extensions enter only when named.

formal.statement: Exact instruction instances and source version to be pinned before the chapter's claims are promoted.

scope: Planned user-mode x86-64 teaching slice; exact manual version and instruction list not yet pinned
notes: Definition worklist, not a claim that Axeyum currently implements x86-64 semantics. AVX2 is outside this base slice.
